title: The Regional Director /Joint Director Incharge
content:
P-11/12/Misc./2024-Rev.II I/3121347/2025

File No. P-11/12/Misc./2024-Rev.II Date: 09.10.2025

To

The Regional Director /Joint Director Incharge
Employees State Insurance Corporation.

Subject: Filing Monthly Contribution showing large no. of tagged employees
with Zero Days- Reg.

Sir,

An analysis of Monthly Contribution (MC) data for the month of March 2025
has been done in respect few big units wherein large no. of employees are tagged
but majority of employees are shown with Zero Contribution Days in the Monthly
Contribution ﬁled. In the MC, remarks against these Zero Contributory Days
employees are shown as On Leave/ No Work.

It is further noticed that majority of these employees with Zero Contributory Days
remains tagged with the employer code since long period and consistently being
shown "On Leave/ No Work", in the MC. This has created doubt that whether they
are (i) on their payroll but on long leave or (ii) have left the insurable employment
(not on their payroll anymore)/ goes beyond ESI wage ceiling but have not been
removed while ﬁling the MC, showing them Left/ Exempted or (iii) showing Zero
Days to evade statutory compliance but keep them on their payroll to pass on their
financial liability to ESIC, in the event of some eventuality.

If a person is shown as employee u/s (9) of the ESI Act, 1948, without actually
being in insurable employment, it is tantamount to submitting false return, a
punishable offense u/s 85(e) of the ESI Act, 1948.

As per the provision u/s 103-A (1) which provide that a person on becoming an
insured person for the ﬁrst time shall be entitled to medical beneﬁt for a period of 3
months provided that where such a person continues for 3 months or more to be an
employee of a factory or establishment to which the Act applies, he shall be entitled
to medical benefit till the beginning of the corresponding benefit period.

title: The Regional Director /Joint Director Incharge
content:
P-11/12/Misc./2024-Rev.II I/3121347/2025

There may be cases where employees have left before three month but shown as
tagged employee for one or other reasons.

In view of the above, regions are requested to analyze the MC data especially in
respect of big units where large no. of employees are shown with Zero Contributory
Days in the MC and analyze the data in consultation with the employers and the
employees left should be asked to be removed form the MC data of such
employers

This issues with the approval of Competent Authority.

Yours faithfully,

(Rakesh Roshan)
Deputy Director (Revenue)
